oracle.description: Reference TypeScript workplan engine, executed as a black box. Outputs are data; no source was copied into this repository.

harness.location: outside this repository (scratch directory); fingerprints only

generation.secondRunRoot: /private/tmp/shiori-fx/rn2/<fixture> (same path length; used for mutation determinism checks)
generation.frozenClock: 2026-01-02T03:04:05.000Z (argument-less Date construction only; Date.now() and lock timing were real)
generation.seededRandom: Math.random replaced by an LCG; generated ids are NOT contractual beyond their format

normalization: Every occurrence of the absolute generation root inside tool output text and error messages is replaced with $ROOT. Output *lengths* (rawOutputLength, UTF-16 code units; rawOutputUtf8Bytes) are measured BEFORE substitution, so they depend on the root path length (/private/tmp/shiori-fx/run/<fixture>). Budget-sensitive comparisons (resume) must be run at a root of the same length or compared by invariants.
Tool outputs are stored parsed ('output') plus outputSha256 of the normalized text; resume/paging-resume vectors store the exact normalized text ('outputText') instead.
Mutation vectors store every changed file's bytes under <vector>.after/ and list them in changedFiles; permission prompts are reduced to their permission name.
Transaction ids, stage-file names and lock nonces are random; fixtures that contain them (pending-journal*) are frozen as files.
rootDependentValues: workplan_compact previewToken and archivePath depend on the absolute canonical root (vector mutations/compact-apply-valid is deterministic only at a fixed root; its second-root run fails token verification, which is expected).
Every absolute path in outputs (path, planPath, directory, workspaceRoot, doctor roots, compact writeIntent).

checkpoint-corrupt.description: Checkpoint sidecar that is not valid JSON, and a dependency sidecar that fails its schema.

checkpoint-legacy-v1.description: Checkpoint schemaVersion 1 (sourceHash): must read as legacy/unverified, never upgraded.

checkpoint-stale-v2.description: Checkpoint v2 written, then the plan changed: checkpoint is stale.

dependencies-invalid.description: Dependency sidecar v1 with a cycle, a self-dependency and references to unknown phase/step ids.

draft-empty.description: Draft with no phases and a blank goal: readable, not executable.

duplicate-step-ids.description: Legacy plan whose phase holds two steps with the same id; targeted operations must refuse.

empty-workspace.description: Workspace with .opencode but no workplan directory.

full-valid.description: All known fields, findings of every severity, spec files, dependencies v1 and a fresh checkpoint v2.

handwritten-md.description: Linked Markdown edited by hand (not equal to generated rendering); one whitespace-only spec.

invalid-schema.description: Documents that fail storage-schema decoding (wrong version, wrong types, bad enum, invalid JSON).

invalid-structure.description: Schema-valid V2 document with structural issues (duplicates, blanks, missing action/validation, bad datetimes).

large-paging.description: Four phases x 40 steps, 30 findings and 60 notes for inspect/resume pagination and budgets.

legacy-fields.description: Legacy V2 shape: no specFiles key, finding without status, unknown metadata at document/phase/step/finding level, large/fractional numbers, duplicate JSON keys.

list-mixed.description: Directory listing classification: valid plans (locale-ordered ids), non-canonical names, invalid JSON, sidecars, locks, temp files, archive, other files.

minimal-valid.description: Smallest executable plan: one phase, one step, generated Markdown, no sidecars.

missing-artifacts.description: Linked Markdown absent and one of two spec files absent; sidecars absent.

pending-journal.description: Update interrupted after the journal and the first artifact were published: pending transaction v1 present.

pending-journal-precreate.description: Create interrupted after the journal was published but before the primary JSON exists.

resume-stress.description: Escape-heavy and very long strings in safety-relevant fields to stress 4096-char resume budgets.

subdir-planfile.description: Plan Markdown linked in a subdirectory of .opencode/workplan; stored spec link uses a legacy './' prefix.

unicode.description: Non-BMP and escape-heavy strings: phase/step ids, titles, notes and spec paths ordered differently by UTF-16 vs code point.
